title: Cryptography, Secrets, and Data Protection
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Cryptography, Secrets, and Data Protection.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Cryptography, Secrets, and Data Protection topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.

notes: Preserves 7 main lesson(s) from the source PDF.
